basics.name: Luigelo Davila
basics.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web, iOS & Cloud)
basics.availability: Open to remote roles across the EU and B2B contracts

summary: Senior full-stack engineer with 5+ years taking products from architecture to production across web, native iOS, Python backends and AWS/Azure cloud. At **Zoloo**, a SaaS platform for bol.com sellers (€2.5B+ in member sales, 20,000+ orders a day), I own the native iOS app and lead the move from a monolith to microservices, including 40M+ records migrated with zero data loss in production. As founder of **Ldvloper**, I designed, built and launched **Syncflow**, an AI goal planner on web and iOS that reached 500+ users in its first month.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer (Mobile & Full-Stack)
bullets: Lead the migration of core business domains from a monolith to microservices (Python, FastAPI, Celery, RabbitMQ, MySQL), moving **40M+ historical records with zero data loss** while the platform stayed live
Own the **native iOS app** (Swift/SwiftUI) end to end, live on the App Store, including passkey authentication, sales dashboards and an AI assistant
Improved production reliability and data integrity through monitoring, incremental rollouts and fixes to long-standing concurrency issues
Ship features across the full stack: backend services, the React web dashboard and bol.com platform integrations
Maintain CI/CD and AWS infrastructure with GitLab CI; hardened platform security with rate limiting, a WAF and email authentication

roles.title: Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
bullets: Led development of the cross-platform mobile app in React Native/Expo, integrated with internal APIs
Built message-driven backend microservices for product synchronization, seller reporting and task automation
Automated deployments and monitoring on AWS (CloudFormation, ECS, CloudWatch)

roles.title: Founder & Principal Engineer
roles.intro: Studio through which I contract with clients on a B2B basis and build my own products.
bullets: Built and launched **Syncflow** (syncflow.me), an AI goal planner on web and native iOS, as sole engineer from product design to App Store release; **500+ users in its first month**
Integrated four LLM providers (Claude, ChatGPT, Groq, Grok) with bring-your-own-key support, plus calendar sync with Apple, Google and Outlook and daily step emails
Designed Autopilot, an agentic assistant with mandatory approval gates and shadow-mode testing before any action runs
Kept infrastructure cost near zero by design on Vercel; payments through Apple and Stripe
Deliver application and cloud security assessments for clients, with hands-on remediation support

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
roles.intro: Led Client Area, the customer-facing portal where Applus+ clients follow their work end to end, from sample tracking to project status and reports.
bullets: Designed the microservices architecture and built its 3 core services in FastAPI and .NET
Built the Next.js, React and TypeScript frontend on a tested component library (unit tests, Storybook)
Took the platform to public launch on the company's new Azure landing zone with the Cloud Center of Competence: Key Vault, virtual network isolation, Azure SQL, Container Registry, Blob Storage
Set up CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and ran delivery in Scrum

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern
roles.intro: Sole developer of an internal platform used by 50+ laboratory staff to plan projects and coordinate resources.
bullets: Built and owned the full stack: Laravel (PHP) REST APIs, Vue.js frontend and MySQL, Dockerized on an on-premise server
Stabilized the platform and worked directly with end users to prioritize and ship improvements

roles.title: Mobile Application Developer
bullets: Built app features in React Native with Redux state management
Built supporting Node.js server components and Dockerized development environments

roles.title: Technical Analyst
roles.intro: Laboratory data analysis and sample classification, before moving into software engineering.
